landing.title:
Africa's voice,
training tomorrow's AI.
landing.subtitle: The first digital academy and crowdsourced platform to preserve African languages and build indigenous speech technologies.

voicePreview.phrase: « Eŋlɔ wò gbe ɖe mɔ̃ me »

how.title: Two Strategic Pillars
how.step1Desc: The official directory to preserve words, definitions, and exact tonal pronunciations.
how.step2Desc: Thousands of community-read sentences to train Speech-to-Text and TTS models.
how.step3Desc: Collaborative validation by native speakers to ensure a high-grade dataset.

markets.label: DEPLOYMENT
markets.title: Official Launch in Ewe (Togo & Ghana).
markets.subtitle: Phase 1: Ewe. The infrastructure is engineered to scale across all African languages.

contribute.title: Voice Studio
contribute.envCheckDesc: To guarantee reference-grade dataset quality and prevent audio rejection, please verify these 3 points before entering the studio.
contribute.oncePerSession: This verification is required once at the start of your recording session.
contribute.quietLabel: I am in a quiet room
contribute.quietDesc: No background music, loud street noise, or direct fans/AC units.
contribute.distanceDesc: About 10–15 cm from my mouth, to capture a clear voice without clipping.
contribute.volumeLabel: My volume and articulation are clear
contribute.volumeDesc: I will speak in a natural and clear tone, respecting tonal pitches.
contribute.modeSubtitle: Select a recording format to enrich the Ewe voice corpus.
contribute.dictionaryPillarDesc: Record individual terms with their definitions to preserve accurate pronunciations and tonal nuances.
contribute.sentencesPillarDesc: Read full sentences in context to model syntax, natural prosody, and conversational rhythm.
contribute.anonymousGateTitle: Create your profile to continue contributing
contribute.anonymousGateDesc: You have recorded your first 3 audios. Create an account to link your future contributions to your profile, track validations, and climb the public leaderboard.

validate.title: Community Quality Control
validate.instruction: Does the audio accurately match the text and correct accent?
validate.emptyDesc: All submitted recordings have been reviewed or the corpus is awaiting new voices. Record phrases to fuel the community validation queue.

leaderboard.title: Language Pioneers
leaderboard.subtitle: Official leaderboard of the top contributors building Africa's digital linguistic heritage.
leaderboard.emptySubtitle: The race to the top begins. Record a first word or phrase to write your name on the podium.
leaderboard.scoringRule: Points: +10 pts / audio · +15 pts if approved · +50 pts Official Voice · +3 pts / validation

profile.title: Profile & Statistics
profile.requireAuthDesc: Sign in to view your profile and contribution metrics.
profile.publicIdentityDesc: This username is displayed publicly on the dictionary ("Voice: @your_handle") and leaderboard.
profile.wordsWonTitle: Words where you are the Official Voice
profile.emptyDesc: Record your first word to appear on the leaderboard and contribute to African language AI.

dictionary.title: Interactive Audio Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Explore, learn, and listen to the Ewe lexical heritage.
dictionary.searchPlaceholder: Search a term in Ewe or English...
dictionary.noResults: No results found in our lexicon.

dictionaryModal.title: Correct or enhance « {word} »
dictionaryModal.subtitle: Suggest an accurate translation to improve dictionary completeness.
dictionaryModal.errorRequired: Please provide at least one translation or definition.

officialVoiceGuide.title: How to become the Official Voice of a dictionary word?
officialVoiceGuide.intro: On Corafric, every dictionary word is recorded by a real speaker. Reference voices are elected by community peer-review through a blind listening protocol.
officialVoiceGuide.step1Desc: Speak in a quiet room respecting the exact tones of the Ewe language.
officialVoiceGuide.step2Desc: Three native speakers evaluate clarity, accent, and tonal precision.
officialVoiceGuide.step3Desc: The highest-rated approved recording for that word is selected.
officialVoiceGuide.step4Desc: Your username is featured publicly on the word card across the global dictionary.

explore.title: African Open Data
explore.subtitle: Explore and download community-collected speech datasets for research and speech AI development.
explore.downloadDesc: The largest open-source Ewe speech dataset, freely accessible for research, universities, and Artificial Intelligence developers.

brandShowcase.description: Corafric: open-source technology platform for the digitization, preservation, and integration of African languages into AI.
brandShowcase.copyright: Corafric. Open linguistic heritage and AI.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Transparent community platform. Speech data released under open CC-BY license. No collection of sensitive personal data. Anonymized recordings for research.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.content: Only essential technical cookies for your session. No advertising trackers. No commercial profiling.
